name: ATC_PRICETAG_RULES
description: A table for storing the rules configured against each pricetag.

columns.name: RULE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the pricetag rule.

columns.name: RULE_PUID
columns.description: Indicates identifier of the pricetag rule.

columns.name: PRICETAG_ID
columns.description: Foreign key of the pricetag to which the rule belongs.

columns.name: PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the product type to which the rule applies. Possible values corresponds to the values in the lov ORA_ATC_PRICETAG_PRODTYPES.

columns.name: RULE_VALUE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of rule value. Possible values corresponds to the values in the lov ORA_PRICE_TAG_RULE.

columns.name: RULE_VALUE
columns.description: Indicates the value in a semicolon seperated format.

columns.name: UOM_VALUE
columns.description: Indicates the unit of measure for which the rule is applicable.

columns.name: BALANCE_ELEM_CODE
columns.description: indicates the currency or non currency balance element code

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
